text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I found Special Week feeling down 
about a slump in her running...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... What in the world should I do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run, it just doesn't 
feel quite right, or something...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At times like that, wouldn't it be good to 
take a break and refresh yourself?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Fuji-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, what should I actually do to clear 
my head?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If you're troubled about running, I think 
doing something else entirely might be 
best.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: For example—swimming, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Swimming, is it...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Wouldn't it be nice to put on your 
favorite swimsuit and go for a swim?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An outfit is like a switch that changes 
your mindset. If you wear something 
different and do something different, your 
mood will shift, too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My favorite swimsuit... Come to think of 
it, I have a new one!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I changed into my swimsuit! How is it? 
Does it suit me?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! Well then, I'll go 
ahead and try swimming right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, when Special Week tried 
swimming...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Incredible! This time is a new record!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So this is the power of a swimsuit...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's good. Looks like you were 
able to reset your mindset.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Somehow... I feel like I can run a 
great race right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All right!
choice_data_list:
Running just like that is a bit too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could stop her, Special Week had 
already dashed off.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, she did say that. Why don't we 
wait and see how things go for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I really did it, Trainer! I set 
a personal best time--!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Swimsuits are amazing! To think they could 
make me feel this full of energy...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Could it be that I can unleash more 
power than usual in other things too... !?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What should I do!?
choice_data_list: Cleaning your room or something like that?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Cleaning the room, right! Understood! I'll 
head over to the dorm for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe-chan's Trainer, Fuji-senpai. Good 
timing. Things have gotten a bit 
bizarre...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Just when I thought Spe-chan had come back 
in her swimsuit, she suddenly started 
cleaning the room...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, actually, the truth is—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You've got to be kidding me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I don't understand. Why would it turn out 
like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Suzuka-san! I'm done cleaning! I made 
sure it's super sparkling clean!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Swimsuits really are amazing, aren't 
they~! Maybe I'll just stay like this for 
a while...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
All the time...!? Spe-chan, please. It's 
distracting, so go put something on...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, I couldn't let her go about in 
a swimsuit forever, so I reasoned with her 
and managed to stop her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Studying! In that case, the library is the 
place to go!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Special Week-san! Why in the world are you 
coming to the library in a swimsuit!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wearing a swimsuit lets me bring out more 
power than usual, so I'm thinking of 
studying for my upcoming tests like this!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't answer my question at all?! 
Doing something like that won't yield any 
results!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, the quiz results came back, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Trainer! I got a way better score on 
my quiz than last time—!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Swimsuits really are amazing after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No way...?! This can't be... impossible! 
For King here... to lose to Special 
Week-san...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, maybe if I put on a 
swimsuit to study too...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a great idea! King-chan, 
let's study in our swimsuits together too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having scored an unexpectedly good grade, 
Special Week was in high spirits and tried 
to invite her friends along too.
